# Text

Applies Kozmos typography, colour, alignment and optional truncation to body text. Choose a semantic element with `as`, or use Heading for a heading with a level-based type scale.

- **Import:** `import { Text } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Foundations
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; no Figma component by design.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/foundations-text--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Text, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function TextExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Text>The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</Text>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Text

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `TextProps`, which extends `Omit<BoxProps, "color">, VariantProps<typeof textVariants>`.

- `as`: `"span" | "p" | "div" | "label" | "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" | "h5" | "h6"`, optional, default `"p"`.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `color`: `"default" | "muted" | "primary" | "destructive" | "white" | null`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `align`: `"end" | "left" | "right" | "start" | "center" | "justify" | null`, optional, default `"start"`.
- `size`: `"sm" | "lg" | "xs" | "base" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl" | "4xl" | null`, optional, default `"base"`.
- `weight`: `"bold" | "normal" | "medium" | "semibold" | null`, optional, default `"normal"`.
- `truncate`: `boolean | null`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
